preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= len(s) for l, r, _ in operations)

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(c for c in s if c not in removed_chars)

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if all(c in removed_chars for c in s) else True
postconditions.description: If all characters in the string are removed, the output should be an empty string.
